reason: A DSH plugin that customizes chat presentation by converting supported inline emojis into selectable built-in or user-uploaded emoji pack images with configurable display sizes.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 聊天回复提供可切换的内置或自定义行内表情包，并支持调整表情显示尺寸。
summaries.en: Customizes DSH chat replies with switchable built-in or user-uploaded inline emoji packs and adjustable display sizes.

capabilities: Replaces supported inline Unicode emojis in chat responses with images from the selected emoji pack
Allows users to select emoji packs and display sizes
Accepts and stores user-uploaded emoji pack ZIP files locally
